question.question: What is the scientific decision for Salvia officinalis for Menopausal hot flashes?

records.notes: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial found Salvia officinalis significantly reduced menopausal rating and hot-flush severity scores and was well tolerated.
records.source_title: Effectiveness and tolerability of a standardized extract from Salvia officinalis in menopausal complaints
